# nico_spectrumx_partition (Resource)

NVIDIA Spectrum-X is an Ethernet networking platform for AI workloads, pairing Spectrum-X switches with SpectrumX SuperNICs to carry east-west GPU-to-GPU traffic. SpectrumX Partitions are the network segments that Instances attach to over those SuperNICs, each identified on the wire by a VXLAN Network Identifier (VNI).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_spectrumx_partition" "example" {
  name                           = "name-value"
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
  labels                         = {
    key = "value"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Partition to create
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site the Partition should belong to

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the Partition
- `labels` (Map of String) String key-value pairs describing Partition labels. Up to 10 key-value pairs can be specified
- `spectrum_x_partition_id` (String) Path parameter: spectrum_x_partition_id.
- `vni` (Number) Requested VXLAN Network Identifier. Omit it to let the Site allocate one from its pool. A requested value that is already allocated or outside that pool is rejected by the Site

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) ISO datetime string for when the SpectrumX Partition was created
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `site` (Attributes) Summary of the Site, present when requested through includeRelation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site))
- `status` (String) Status of the SpectrumX Partition. A Partition becomes Ready once the Site reports it in inventory
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Status detail records for the SpectrumX Partition over time (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `tenant` (Attributes) Summary of the Tenant, present when requested through includeRelation (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenant))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant that owns the Partition
- `updated` (String) ISO datetime string for when the SpectrumX Partition was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--site"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site`

Read-Only:

- `capabilities` (Attributes) Site capabilities used for feature availability and configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site--capabilities))
- `id` (String) Unique UUID v4 identifier for the Site
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the Site
- `is_online` (Boolean) Indicates if the Site is currently reachable from Cloud
- `is_serial_console_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if Serial Console is enabled for the Site by the Provider
- `name` (String) Name of the Site
- `status` (String) Status of the Site

<a id="nestedatt--site--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site.capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `dps_power_management` (Boolean) Whether this Site accepts non-empty power resource groups and power profiles for DPS power management. When false, omission and explicit clearing remain allowed.
- `flow` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports Flow-based operations
- `image_based_operating_system` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports image-based operating system provisioning
- `native_networking` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports native networking
- `network_security_group` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports Network Security Groups
- `nv_link_partition` (Boolean) Whether the Site supports NVLink partitioning
- `vpc_slaac` (Boolean) Whether the latest successfully stored Site configuration inventory reports that Core supports VPCs with SLAAC enabled. False also represents a missing Site configuration or an inventory report that omits the capability. This value is managed by Site configuration inventory and cannot be updated through the Site API.

### Nested Schema for `tenant.capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `targeted_instance_creation` (Boolean) Deprecated in favor of TenantAccount.siteCapabilities. On GET `/tenant/current`, the property is present and true only when every Ready Tenant Account enables TargetedInstanceCreation and no Tenant Site explicitly disables it; otherwise it is omitted.
